subject.title: [codex] Fix Claude auto fallback for MCP-only keychain

question: Should the current hardened head wait for redacted live MCP-only Keychain fallback proof, or is the focused prompt-free test matrix sufficient with an explicit owner waiver?
rationale: Repository policy prevents autonomous prompt-prone Keychain validation, while the remaining uncertainty concerns real credential-state classification and fallback execution rather than a concrete code defect.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Request redacted logs or terminal output from a real affected setup running the current head before merge.

options.title: Record an owner waiver
options.body: Explicitly accept the compatibility matrix and narrowly gated implementation as sufficient evidence without a live MCP-only reproduction.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted logs or terminal output from a real affected setup running the current head before merge.
